mistakes.text: If she had bought thicker paper, the bouquet would have been perfect now.
mistakes.normalized: if she had bought thicker paper the bouquet would have been perfect now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Následok platí teraz („now“), preto v Mixed Conditional: „would be perfect“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Následek platí teď („now“), proto v Mixed Conditional: „would be perfect“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The result is about now, so the Mixed Conditional needs “would be perfect”, not “would have been”.

mistakes.text: If she bought thicker paper, the bouquet would be perfect now.
mistakes.normalized: if she bought thicker paper the bouquet would be perfect now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nákup bol v minulosti, preto po „if“ patrí Past Perfect: „had bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nákup byl v minulosti, proto po „if“ patří Past Perfect: „had bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The buying was in the past, so the if-clause needs the Past Perfect: “had bought”.

mistakes.text: If she would have bought thicker paper, the bouquet would be perfect now.
mistakes.normalized: if she would have bought thicker paper the bouquet would be perfect now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; správne je Past Perfect: „if she had bought“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; správně je Past Perfect: „if she had bought“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; use the Past Perfect: “if she had bought”.

mistakes.text: If she had bought more thick paper, the bouquet would be perfect now.
mistakes.normalized: if she had bought more thick paper the bouquet would be perfect now
mistakes.feedback_sk: Krátke prídavné meno stupňujeme príponou: „thicker“, nie „more thick“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Krátké přídavné jméno stupňujeme příponou: „thicker“, ne „more thick“.

mistakes.text: If she had bought a thicker paper, the bouquet would be perfect now.
mistakes.normalized: if she had bought a thicker paper the bouquet would be perfect now
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Paper“ ako materiál je nepočítateľné, preto bez „a“: „thicker paper“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Paper“ jako materiál je nepočitatelné, proto bez „a“: „thicker paper“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Paper” as a material is uncountable, so no “a”: “thicker paper”.

source_issues: CZ 'silnější papír' can also be read as 'stronger paper'; only thicker/heavier accepted, matching SK 'hrubší'.
